unlockConfirm.body: Their unpublished work will be shelved on the forge, on a branch in their name, with their own token; their space on the server will be removed and the branch freed. When they take over again, their work will be merged into the up-to-date branch.

unlocked.shelved: Branch freed; the unpublished work is shelved on {{branch}}.
unlocked.free: Branch freed; there was nothing to shelve.

holds.shelvedMine: You have work shelved on this branch: taking over again will merge it into the up-to-date branch.
